title: Planning and Design of Drainage in Irrigation Projects - Guidelines
clause_1_scope: This standard lays down the guidelines for planning and design of drainage system in irrigation projects including the guidelines for dealing with the problem of drainage in the command areas of irrigation projects.
clause_3_terminology: Planning and Design of Drainage in Irrigation Projects
Planning and Design of Drainage in Irrigation Projects - Guidelines

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
